narrative_purpose: Show the Na'vi luminous freckles as an honest, un-fakeable signal: the same bilateral pattern on two figures at two intensities — bright on one mid-exertion, soft on a calm one — so the reader sees that the glow tracks inner state and follows the body's own nerves and vessels.
subject: A close naturalist study of two Na'vi heads-and-shoulders side by side at night, blue skin marked with fine cyan-white luminous freckles in precise bilateral lines along the cheekbones, brow, neck and collarbone; on the left figure the freckles glow bright and hot with exertion, on the right figure the same pattern rests soft and dim with calm.
scene: Against a dark forest-night ground, the two figures lit chiefly by their own skin-light, faint teal haze behind.
camera: A close portrait framing of both figures' faces and upper shoulders, even and observational.
light: Self-luminous skin freckles as the key light, brighter on the aroused figure; cool ambient indigo fill; no external warm source so the colour reads as one blue-white hue at two intensities.
palette: Na'vi indigo-blue skin, Pandora cyan and mist-white in the freckles, void-indigo ground; strictly no hue shift between the two states — only intensity.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted skin texture, observed portrait energy.
detail_level: Crisp on the freckle-lines and their bilateral tracing of vessels and nerves; backgrounds soft.
composition: Two near-symmetric portraits side by side for direct comparison, dark space above and between for callout labels.
consistency_notes: Single blue-white photophore hue at two brightnesses (canon: intensity changes, not colour); freckles trace vessels and nerves in mirrored bilateral lines; same Na'vi skin treatment as other chapters.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no multicolour glow
